about: ARCHITECTURE §5.3 look-match reference views (D179, C). Each view is a fixed camera on an AC track installed locally (set each track's folder and models to it), anchored to one of the track's own AC_ dummies (every AC track has them; the start grid and pit boxes carry the race direction). The camera sits `up` m above the anchor, `forward` m along its race direction and `right` m to its right, and looks along the race direction turned by `yawDeg` (+ = left) and `pitchDeg` (+ = up), with a vertical field of view `fovDeg`, at `width` × `height` pixels. src/lookmatch/cameras.js resolves a view to a world pose; scripts/lookmatch.js prints those poses so the same views can be set up in AC. The values are C's choice (inferred: a driver's eye height of 1.1 m, AC's default 56° field of view), not measured in AC. The reference weather and time are the preview's (app/preview/aclook.js LIGHT: 14:00, sun 42° up at azimuth 225°), and the AC shots must be taken at that time, in clear weather, with CSP.
